items.raw_excerpt: Monday September 7th could be a key date for the full enforcement of the EU's biometric border checks with concerns raised that queues at border checks could get longer and slower this month.
items.summary_en: The EU's new biometric border entry system, called EES, is set to start full enforcement on September 7th. Travelers crossing European borders may face longer and slower queues as the system is rolled out. Officials worry that the changes could cause major delays at busy border crossings.
items.summary_ko: EU의 새로운 생체인식 출입국 시스템(EES)이 9월 7일부터 전면 시행될 예정이다. 국경을 넘어가는 여행자들은 시스템 도입으로 대기 시간이 길어질 수 있다. 당국은 주요 국경 검문소에서 큰 혼잡이 발생할 수 있다고 우려하고 있다.
items.title_en: EU biometric border checks could mean longer queues this month
items.title_ko: EU 생체인식 국경검사, 이달 중 대기 줄 더 길어질 수 있어
items.title_original: Could Europe's border queues get longer this month as key EES date passes?

items.raw_excerpt: The record-breaking temperatures and prolonged drought that struck Switzerland this summer are impacting the prices of certain consumer goods this autumn.
items.summary_en: Switzerland had its hottest summer since records began in 1864. Now potatoes, milk products, petrol, and heating oil all cost more. Farmers lost half a billion francs and some had to sell their cows.
items.summary_ko: 스위스는 1864년 기록 시작 이래 가장 더운 여름을 보냈다. 감자와 유제품, 휘발유, 난방유 가격이 모두 올랐다. 농가 피해는 5억 프랑에 달해 일부 농민은 소를 처분해야 했다.
items.title_en: What costs more in Switzerland this autumn after the summer drought?
items.title_ko: 스위스에서 여름 가뭄 이후 이번 가을 비싸지는 품목들
items.title_original: What costs more in Switzerland  this autumn after summer drought?

items.summary_en: Poland will start using reclaimed sewage water to cool power plants from January 2027. The new law aims to reduce freshwater use and protect the power system from droughts. State company Orlen Termika plans to invest over one billion zloty to connect treatment plants with power facilities near Warsaw.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드는 2027년 1월부터 하수 처리수를 발전소 냉각에 사용하기 시작한다. 새 법은 담수 사용을 줄이고 가뭄으로부터 전력 시스템을 보호하기 위한 것이다. 국영기업 Orlen Termika는 바르샤바 인근 처리장과 발전시설을 연결하는 데 10억 즐로티 이상을 투자할 계획이다.
items.title_en: Poland to use sewage water for cooling power plants
items.title_ko: 폴란드, 하수 처리수로 발전소 냉각에 나서
items.title_original: Poland to begin using sewage water to cool power plants

items.raw_excerpt: These nine idyllic small towns in Maine range from the North Woods wilderness near Millinocket to the easternmost lighthouse in Lubec and Acadia's Bar.

items.raw_excerpt: Germany has a strong wellness culture that dates back more than 2,000 years. If you're looking to take a dip in mineral waters or sweat it out in the sauna, spa towns – known as 'Kurorte' – offer the perfect weekend break.
items.summary_en: Germany has a wellness tradition spanning over 2,000 years. Small spa towns called Kurorte offer mineral baths and saunas for a relaxing weekend trip. These charming towns are perfect for anyone looking to unwind in nature.

items.raw_excerpt: Finding a job or a place to live in Switzerland can be hard enough without the prospect of facing discrimination. We want to hear from readers about their own experiences.
items.summary_en: A Swiss news outlet is asking readers to share their personal stories about facing discrimination when looking for a job or a flat in Switzerland. Finding work or a place to live in Switzerland is already challenging, and the article explores how discrimination makes it even harder for many people.

items.raw_excerpt: Land subsidence near Farakka has disrupted train services to north Bengal, prompting the deployment of extra buses for commuters.
